adjudication_scope: Codex AI review of PubMed titles and abstracts from three live shadow runs; diagnostic only and not independent human-expert evidence.

cases.goal: Identify primary biomedical evidence about EGFR T790M-mediated resistance to first-generation EGFR inhibitors and response to osimertinib in non-small-cell lung cancer.
cases.instructions: Prioritize primary human clinical or translational studies directly connecting EGFR T790M with acquired resistance or osimertinib response.
inclusion_criteria: EGFR T790M in non-small-cell lung cancer
exclusion_criteria: Non-human study unrelated to clinical resistance

records.title: Osimertinib or Platinum-Pemetrexed in EGFR T790M-Positive Lung Cancer.
records.evidence_excerpt: A randomized phase 3 trial compared osimertinib with platinum-pemetrexed in patients with T790M-positive advanced non-small-cell lung cancer after progression on first-line EGFR therapy.
records.expected_reason: Direct primary human trial evidence for osimertinib response in T790M-positive NSCLC.

records.title: AZD9291 in EGFR inhibitor-resistant non-small-cell lung cancer.
records.evidence_excerpt: Patients with advanced EGFR inhibitor-resistant lung cancer received AZD9291, with activity evaluated in tumors carrying the EGFR T790M resistance mutation.
records.expected_reason: Primary clinical evidence directly addresses T790M-mediated resistance and osimertinib precursor response.

records.title: Temporal changes of EGFR mutations and T790M levels in tumour and plasma DNA following AZD9291 treatment.
records.evidence_excerpt: Paired tumor and plasma samples from patients treated with AZD9291 were used to track T790M and resistance evolution.
records.expected_reason: Primary translational evidence directly measures T790M during osimertinib precursor treatment.

records.title: Targeting common EGFR mutations in non-small cell lung cancer: a review of global phase 3 trials of third-generation inhibitors.
records.evidence_excerpt: This secondary review summarizes global phase 3 trials of third-generation EGFR inhibitors.
records.expected_reason: The objective requested primary evidence, not a secondary review.

records.title: Role of osimertinib in the treatment of EGFR-mutation positive non-small-cell lung cancer.
records.evidence_excerpt: This review discusses osimertinib across EGFR-mutated non-small-cell lung cancer treatment settings.
records.expected_reason: A broad treatment review is not direct primary T790M evidence.

records.title: Afatinib: a second-generation EGF receptor and ErbB tyrosine kinase inhibitor for the treatment of advanced non-small-cell lung cancer.
records.evidence_excerpt: A secondary overview describes afatinib treatment and resistance in advanced non-small-cell lung cancer.
records.expected_reason: The paper centers on afatinib rather than primary osimertinib response evidence.

records.title: The increase in activating EGFR mutation in plasma is an early biomarker to monitor response to osimertinib: a case report.
records.evidence_excerpt: A single case tracked activating EGFR mutation levels during osimertinib treatment without directly establishing T790M-mediated resistance.
records.expected_reason: The case does not directly establish the requested T790M resistance relationship.

records.title: The role of afatinib in the management of non-small cell lung carcinoma.
records.evidence_excerpt: A secondary article discusses afatinib and general mechanisms of acquired resistance in lung carcinoma.
records.expected_reason: The intervention and evidence type do not satisfy the primary osimertinib objective.

cases.goal: Identify primary human evidence linking pathogenic BRCA1 variants to breast or ovarian cancer risk and clinically relevant penetrance.
cases.instructions: Prioritize primary cohort, case-control, or segregation studies with direct BRCA1 variant and cancer-risk evidence.
inclusion_criteria: Breast or ovarian cancer risk outcome

records.title: Impact of germline variants on breast and ovarian cancer risk in Japanese women: an original cohort study and meta-analysis.
records.evidence_excerpt: A large human case-control cohort estimated breast and ovarian cancer risks associated with pathogenic BRCA1 and BRCA2 variants.
records.expected_reason: Direct primary human risk evidence includes BRCA1 pathogenic variants.

records.title: BRCA1 R1699Q variant displaying ambiguous functional abrogation confers intermediate breast and ovarian cancer risk.
records.evidence_excerpt: Family and genetic evidence estimated intermediate breast and ovarian cancer risk for the BRCA1 R1699Q variant.
records.expected_reason: Direct variant-specific BRCA1 risk evidence.

records.title: Breast cancer risk for Korean women with germline mutations in BRCA1 and BRCA2.
records.evidence_excerpt: A hereditary cancer cohort estimated age-specific breast cancer penetrance for BRCA1 and BRCA2 mutation carriers.
records.expected_reason: Direct human penetrance evidence for BRCA1 carriers.

records.title: A tandem duplication of BRCA1 exons 1-19 through DHX8 exon 2 in four families with hereditary breast and ovarian cancer syndrome.
records.evidence_excerpt: Four families provided segregation and clinical-significance evidence for a large BRCA1 structural variant.
records.expected_reason: Primary family evidence directly links a BRCA1 pathogenic structural variant to HBOC.

records.title: Association of gene variant type and location with breast cancer risk in the general population.
records.evidence_excerpt: A population case-control analysis evaluated breast cancer risk by pathogenic variant type and location in BRCA1 and other susceptibility genes.
records.expected_reason: Primary population evidence reports BRCA1 pathogenic-variant risk.

records.title: Contribution of germline BRCA1 and BRCA2 sequence alterations to breast cancer in Northern India.
records.evidence_excerpt: Cases and controls were analyzed for BRCA1 and BRCA2 germline changes and breast cancer susceptibility.
records.expected_reason: Primary human evidence directly assesses BRCA1 alterations and breast cancer risk.

records.title: BRCA1 and BRCA2 whole cDNA analysis in unsolved hereditary breast/ovarian cancer patients.
records.evidence_excerpt: The analysis searched for non-coding splice variants in unsolved hereditary cancer cases but did not estimate penetrance or cancer risk.
records.expected_reason: Variant discovery without a direct risk or penetrance outcome does not satisfy the objective.

records.title: Screening for BRCA1, BRCA2, CHEK2, PALB2, BRIP1, RAD50, and CDH1 mutations in high-risk Finnish BRCA1/2-founder mutation-negative breast and/or ovarian cancer individuals.
records.evidence_excerpt: A mutation-screening project focused on unresolved founder-negative families and additional genes rather than BRCA1 penetrance.
records.expected_reason: The study does not directly estimate pathogenic BRCA1 risk or penetrance.

records.title: Germline pathogenic variant spectrum in 25 cancer susceptibility genes in Turkish breast and colorectal cancer patients and elderly controls.
records.evidence_excerpt: A broad panel described variant frequencies across 25 genes and two cancers without a direct BRCA1 penetrance estimate.
records.expected_reason: Broad panel frequency evidence is not specific BRCA1 risk evidence.

records.title: Pathogenic and likely pathogenic variants in PALB2, CHEK2, and other known breast cancer susceptibility genes among 1054 BRCA-negative Hispanics with breast cancer.
records.evidence_excerpt: The cohort explicitly excluded BRCA mutation carriers and evaluated PALB2, CHEK2, and other susceptibility genes.
records.expected_reason: A BRCA-negative cohort centered on other genes cannot establish BRCA1 risk.

records.title: Pathogenic and likely pathogenic variants in PALB2, CHEK2, and other known breast cancer susceptibility genes among 1054 BRCA-negative Hispanics with breast cancer.
records.evidence_excerpt: The duplicate source record was returned by a second search and remained off target for BRCA1.
records.expected_reason: Duplicate off-target evidence remains a rejection.

records.title: Penetrance of male breast cancer susceptibility genes: a systematic review.
records.evidence_excerpt: A systematic review summarizes male breast cancer susceptibility genes rather than providing primary BRCA1 risk evidence for the requested population.
records.expected_reason: Secondary evidence does not satisfy the primary-study objective.

records.title: Almost 2% of Spanish breast cancer families are associated to germline pathogenic mutations in the ATM gene.
records.evidence_excerpt: The family evidence concerns pathogenic ATM mutations in BRCA1/2-negative families.
records.expected_reason: ATM evidence is not BRCA1 evidence.

records.title: Clinical implications of germline mutations in breast cancer genes: RECQL.
records.evidence_excerpt: The article reviews evidence for RECQL as a proposed hereditary breast cancer gene.
records.expected_reason: RECQL evidence is not BRCA1 evidence and is secondary.

records.title: Does familial breast cancer and thymoma suggest a cancer syndrome? A family perspective.
records.evidence_excerpt: A family with breast or ovarian cancer and thymoma had an untested candidate variant without established BRCA1 pathogenicity.
records.expected_reason: The record does not provide pathogenic BRCA1 risk evidence.

cases.goal: Identify primary clinical evidence that elexacaftor-tezacaftor-ivacaftor improves lung function in people with cystic fibrosis carrying at least one CFTR F508del allele.
cases.instructions: Prioritize randomized trials and prospective clinical studies reporting lung-function outcomes for people with at least one F508del allele.
inclusion_criteria: Clinical study in people with cystic fibrosis
At least one CFTR F508del allele

records.title: Efficacy and Safety of Elexacaftor/Tezacaftor/Ivacaftor in Children 6 Through 11 Years of Age with Cystic Fibrosis Heterozygous for F508del and a Minimal Function Mutation: A Phase 3b, Randomized, Placebo-controlled Study.
records.evidence_excerpt: A randomized placebo-controlled phase 3b trial in children with F508del showed an 11-point between-group improvement in percent predicted FEV1.
records.expected_reason: Direct primary F508del clinical trial evidence reports lung-function improvement after ETI.

records.title: Elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor in children aged 6 years or older with cystic fibrosis heterozygous for F508del and a minimal function mutation: results from a 96-week open-label extension study.
records.evidence_excerpt: A 96-week extension in children with F508del reported sustained lung-function benefits after ETI.
records.expected_reason: Primary longitudinal F508del clinical evidence reports the requested outcome.

records.title: Effect of elexacaftor-tezacaftor-ivacaftor on bronchial dilatations in adolescents with cystic fibrosis: a multicentre prospective observational study.
records.evidence_excerpt: A prospective F508del adolescent cohort showed a sustained 14-point improvement in percent predicted FEV1 after ETI.
records.expected_reason: Primary prospective evidence directly reports F508del lung-function improvement.

records.title: Long-Term Safety and Efficacy of Elexacaftor/Tezacaftor/Ivacaftor in Adults and Adolescents with Cystic Fibrosis and at Least One F508del Allele: A Phase 3 Open-Label Extension Study.
records.evidence_excerpt: A 192-week phase 3 extension in people with at least one F508del allele reported sustained improvements in lung function after ETI.
records.expected_reason: Direct long-term primary clinical evidence satisfies population, therapy, and outcome criteria.

records.title: Use of elexacaftor plus tezacaftor plus ivacaftor in individuals with cystic fibrosis and at least one F508del allele: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
records.evidence_excerpt: A systematic review combines prior randomized evidence rather than reporting a new primary clinical cohort.
records.expected_reason: The objective explicitly prioritizes primary clinical evidence.

records.title: CFTR Modulators in People with Cystic Fibrosis: Real-World Evidence in France.
records.evidence_excerpt: A narrative review summarizes French registry projects and prior CFTR modulator trials.
records.expected_reason: A narrative review is not direct primary ETI lung-function evidence.

records.title: Impact of the expanded label for elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor in people with cystic fibrosis with no F508del variant in the USA.
records.evidence_excerpt: The registry population explicitly carried no F508del variant.
records.expected_reason: The population contradicts the required F508del criterion.

cases.goal: Identify primary EGFR T790M and osimertinib evidence in non-small-cell lung cancer.
cases.instructions: Prioritize direct human clinical evidence and exclude generic reviews without study evidence.
exclusion_criteria: Generic review without case-level or study evidence

records.title: Osimertinib or Platinum-Pemetrexed in EGFR T790M-Positive Lung Cancer.
records.evidence_excerpt: This primary clinical study provides direct T790M-positive treatment evidence.
records.expected_reason: The record is precisely the primary evidence requested.

records.title: AZD9291 in EGFR inhibitor-resistant non-small-cell lung cancer.
records.evidence_excerpt: The evidence reports a primary human study of T790M-positive inhibitor-resistant lung cancer.
records.expected_reason: The record directly satisfies the objective.

records.title: Temporal changes of EGFR mutations and T790M levels in tumour and plasma DNA following AZD9291 treatment.
records.evidence_excerpt: Case-level translational evidence follows T790M during AZD9291 treatment.
records.expected_reason: The record is direct case-level evidence, not a generic review.
